title: Set current profile in the profile tab when opening the profile tab
body:
When opening the profile-tab in AAPS the profile shown might not be the one that is currently active! If you want to edit your profile, let's say scale up or down or change any values, you need to pay attention to edit the CURRENT  profile ,which might not be the one shown.  It would be safer, if always the current/ active profile is listed when opening the tab!

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d7898a5-effd-4965-9856-a728b4c4f504)

comments.body: That would be a really useful change. I've often made the mistake of editing the wrong profile myself.
AAPS 4 will have different UI. this is already implemented
